description: This Swift file defines a SwiftUI View component called HomeToolbar, which implements a customizable toolbar for a home screen interface. It includes subviews for status, actions, and interaction handling, utilizing environment variables and bindings for dynamic UI updates.

classes.name: HomeToolbarStatusButton
classes.description: A subview representing the status indicator button, showing gateway status and activity icons, with animation and accessibility features.

classes.name: HomeToolbarActionButton
classes.description: A reusable button component for action icons with customizable appearance, states, and accessibility labels.

methods.name: updatePulse
methods.description: Handles the pulsing animation for the connecting gateway status indicator.

calls: self.updatePulse(for: self.gateway, scenePhase: self.scenePhase, reduceMotion: self.reduceMotion)
